title: Trumpeter George Mitchell and working with Jelly Roll Morton
summary: She recalls George Mitchell as tall and skinny and says she also worked with Jelly Roll.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Was he? I don't know. But he used to play with Jellyroll. Later on, in the '20s, he played with Jellyroll Morton.
You know, I worked with Jellyroll, too.
Yes, I know. I wanted to ask you about that.
Uh-huh. I don't -- George Mitchell. Maybe it'll come to me, but I can't recall right now. But anyhow, now we're going from the De Luxe.
